decision: Use simulation-domain heartbeat age referenced to the latest wall-fresh journaled IMU; retain wall deadlines for high-rate sources, queues, native work and supervision.
rejected: derive a dynamic timeout from observed real-time factor

sources.title: PX4 ROS 2 User Guide
sources.finding: GZBridge updates PX4 time from Gazebo each simulation step; OS time is only suitable when real-time factor is close to one.

sources.title: PX4 Gazebo Sim documentation
sources.finding: PX4 and Gazebo run in lockstep and simulation may run slower or faster than real time.

sources.title: MAVLink Heartbeat Protocol
sources.finding: Heartbeat rate and disconnect timeout are channel-specific policy.

sources.title: MAVSDK Heartbeat Watchdog
sources.finding: A watchdog fed exactly at its timeout is sensitive to scheduling jitter; configured timeout needs margin.

licenses.MAVLink documentation: repository terms retained; documentation consulted only

resource_cost: fixed JSON replay and unit tests only; no PX4, Gazebo, OpenVINS or training process
